acceptanceCriteria.details: prompt and confirm render an empty suffix with no inserted character, render custom suffixes exactly, and preserve default ': ' behavior. Prompt input, confirmation parsing, defaults, and hidden input remain functional.

tests.details: Focused suffix regression: 6 passed, 168 deselected. Full practical suite: 1,308 passed, 21 skipped, 1 xfailed, 0 failed.

regressions.details: Independent probes covered suffixes '', '>', ': ', '>> ', Unicode, tab, and newline; visible and hidden input; password confirmation; yes/no parsing; invalid-answer retry; true/false/None defaults; and completely empty prompt text. For every nonempty built prompt, the echoed prefix plus the input-function argument exactly reconstructed the prompt and the input function received its final character.

explainability.details: The repair applies one invariant to both APIs: echo all but the final built-prompt character and pass that final character to the input function. This preserves exact suffix rendering and the readline-safe delegated-character call shape without a special case.

prReadiness.details: The two-function change is symmetric and localized, has six focused public-output cases, passes independent call-boundary probes and the full suite, and has clean provenance, lint, type, build, compile, and whitespace evidence.

build.details: uv build produced click-8.3.dev0 source and wheel distributions; compileall passed for src and tests.

lint.details: Ruff check and Ruff format --check passed on both changed files; git diff --check passed.

typecheck.details: Configured strict MyPy completed successfully with no issues in 26 source files.

provenance.notes: A fresh repository fetched only the supplied pre-fix SHA. The current iteration-2 patch applied cleanly and reconstructed the exact tree of the claimed frozen commit, whose sole parent is the supplied pre-fix SHA. Attempt-1 artifacts were left preserved and unchanged. No accepted fix or post-fix upstream source was inspected.

limitations: Python 3.12.14 on Linux only; the upstream interpreter, interactive-terminal, and Windows matrices were not run.
Readline protection was verified at the input-function call boundary rather than through a real interactive readline session.
A completely empty built prompt necessarily passes an empty string because no final character exists; exact empty rendering and return behavior were verified.
scope: Independent iteration-2 frozen-revision QA; no patch changes and no public actions.
